wins: Mapped all exposed services with versioned nmap scans and recorded consistent banner data for prioritized follow-ups (ep001_step05).
Triggered credential repurposing logic by harvesting SSH key fingerprint and verifying reuse potential on ancillary hosts (ep001_step11).
Maintained high reward score through persistent reconnaissance even though automation did not reach final success criteria.
fails: Never achieved mission success because privilege escalation step repeatedly blocked by strict sudo restrictions and missing exploitable binaries (ep001_step18).
Mentor calls (15) indicate difficulty transitioning from enumeration to exploitation under time pressure, leaving valuable artifacts unused.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance phase produced high rewards but failure to complete exploit/persistence steps signals need for refined escalation strategy.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts stall when sudo access is absent and no writable suid binaries are identified.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected from nmap
skill_cards.then_action: Run automated SSH enumeration with targeted scripts and credential testing.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS responds with 200 and directory indexing or ambiguous content
skill_cards.then_action: Execute recursive gobuster scan plus nikto content checks to pinpoint hidden endpoints.

skill_cards.if_condition: When ssh session establishes and sudo -l shows limited commands
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate binary file capabilities, search for writable suid/sgid files, and chain with custom exploit scripts.

memory_ops.reason: High success in collecting credentials and host data during reconnaissance.
Consistent extraction of valuable endpoint information drove reward despite final failure.

next_experiments.title: Structured Escalation Playbook
next_experiments.description: Automate systematic sudo/priv escalation enumeration (sudo -l, capabilities, suid search) before attempting exploit chaining to avoid dead-ends.

next_experiments.title: Credential Finding Amplification
next_experiments.description: Expand SSH credential reuse trials with harvested keys and password candidates, then pivot to secondary hosts observed in logs.

next_experiments.title: Artifact Utilization Tracker
next_experiments.description: Develop checklist to log enumerated artifacts and ensure actionable leads feed into exploitation steps instead of being discarded.
